newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Verbund 1996 pretax up, net down 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Verbund 1996 pretax up, net down 3 pct.

text.p: Austrian national grid company Verbund reported on Monday an eight percent increase in 1996 pretax profit and a three percent fall in net profit.
Verbund said pretax profit rose to 1.53 billion schillings, but did not give an absolute figure for 1996 net profit. In 1995, net profit reached 1.38 billion schillings.
Sales climbed 1.8 percent to 20 billion schillings in 1996 due to higher domestic electricity sales.
"Also the electricity tariff increase of 2.8 percent, effective as of June 1, 1995, exerted a positive influence over a period of five months (January to May)," Verbund said in a statement.
Operating profit reached 3.05 billion schillings, down 28 percent from 1995.

Operating profit was influenced by increased sales revenues, positive effects from ongoing cost cutting measures, higher expenses due to fuel and electricity purchase costs and an extraordinary expense of 800 million schillings, it said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
